title: Arrival Of V. Kiriloff, Soviet Diplomatic Official

page_data.en:
FORM No. 3
G. 35,000-1-35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
6730
Section 2, Special Branch,
REPORT
Date May 21, 1935.

Subject Arrival of V. Kiriloff, Soviet diplomatic official.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [签名] D.D.

Vasily Kiriloff, 34, Soviet citizen, arrived at Shanghai
from Moscow via Japan on May 19, 1935, by the s.s. "Empress
of Asia," accompanied by his daughter Nina Kiriloff, 9 years
of age. He is in possession of Passport No. 11642 issued
on February 17, 1935, at Moscow by the Peoples Commissariat
for Foreign Affairs. A Chinese visa was issued on
February 24, 1935, at Moscow. Kiriloff states that he is
a secretary of the U.S.S.R. Consulate General at Shanghai,
and will reside at No. 1 Whangpoo Road.

[签名: D. Tcheremshansky]
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

表格第3号
G. 35,000-1-35

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号：S. B. 登记处。
6730
特务科第二股，
报告
日期：1935年5月21日。

事由：苏联外交官员 V. Kiriloff 抵沪。

呈报人：D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人：[签名] D.D.

Vasily Kiriloff，34岁，苏联公民，于1935年5月19日乘坐“亚细亚皇后”号轮船（s.s. "Empress of Asia"），经日本从莫斯科抵达上海，随行有其9岁的女儿 Nina Kiriloff。他持有1935年2月17日由莫斯科苏联人民外交委员会签发的第11642号护照。中国签证于1935年2月24日在莫斯科签发。Kiriloff 称其系苏联驻上海总领事馆秘书，将居住于黄浦路1号。

[签名: D. Tcheremshansky]
D. S.

副总监（特务科）。
